full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《砷掺杂和硼掺杂硅系统热特性的统一机器学习原子间势》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Conditional Phase Sensitivity and Atom–RestCorrelations in a Diamond Four-LevelOptomechanical Cavity
full_list.title_zh: 金刚石四能级光机械腔中的条件相敏性和原子静止相关性
full_list.abstract: We investigate how phase information initially stored in a diamond four-level atom is redistributed when the atom interacts with a quantized cavity field and a mechanical mode. The phase φ is encoded in the atomic superposition (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2, while the optical and mechanical subsystems start in Fock states. The dynamics are generated by a coarse-grained optomechanical Hamiltonian together with normalized non-Hermitian no-jump evolution. A central point of the analysis is that the induced |2rangle↔|3rangle channel contains the distinct photon operators adagger ka^k and a^kadagger k; they cannot be merged without changing the dynamics. The numerical study is deliberately restricted to the stationary, single-photon case k=1, for which the calculation is reproducible and the Hilbert-space truncation can be checked directly. We track the reduced-atomic quantum Fisher information (QFI), von Neumann entropy, purity, and total l₁ coherence. In the parameter range considered, increasing the optomechanical coupling G reduces the maximum conditioned atom--rest entropy from about 1.676 to 0.374 bits and raises the minimum atomic purity from about 0.356 to 0.876. At the same time, the time-averaged local QFI decreases from about 0.450 to 0.336, while the mean total coherence changes only weakly and non-monotonically. Thus stronger optomechanical coupling does not improve all quantum resources simultaneously: it keeps the conditioned atomic state purer and less entangled with the rest, but it also reduces the amount of phase information locally accessible from the atom. To expose this contrast more clearly, the time-dependent observables are plotted for two complementary combinations of G values, and the full nine-point coupling scan is summarized separately.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了当原子与量子化腔场和机械模式相互作用时，最初存储在金刚石四能级原子中的相位信息如何重新分布。相位 φ 以原子叠加 (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2 编码，而光学和机械子系统以 Fock 状态启动。动力学是由粗粒度光机械哈密顿量与归一化非厄米无跳演化一起生成的。分析的中心点是诱导 |2rangle↔|3rangle 通道包含不同的光子算子 adagger ka^k 和 a^kadagger k；如果不改变动态，它们就无法合并。数值研究有意限制在稳态、单光子情况 k=1 的情况下，计算是可重复的，并且可以直接检查希尔伯特空间截断。我们跟踪简化原子量子费希尔信息 (QFI)、冯诺依曼熵、纯度和总 l₁ 相干性。在所考虑的参数范围内，增加光机耦合 G 可将最大条件原子静止熵从约 1.676 降低至 0.374 位，并将最小原子纯度从约 0.356 提高至 0.876。与此同时，时间平均局部 QFI 从大约 0.450 下降到 0.336，而平均总相干性仅微弱且非单调地变化。因此，更强的光机耦合并不能同时改善所有量子资源：它使条件原子态保持更纯净并且与其余原子态的纠缠更少，但它也减少了从原子本地访问的相位信息量。为了更清楚地揭示这种对比，针对 G 值的两个互补组合绘制了随时间变化的可观测值，并单独总结了完整的九点耦合扫描。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于基于高性能有机摩擦纳米发电机的机电能量收集的铁电向列液晶定制 PVDF 复合薄膜中的界面电荷动力学和极化耦合》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A fly-inspired directional microphone with integrated-photonic microring resonator transduction
full_list.title_zh: 具有集成光子微环谐振器传导功能的受苍蝇启发的定向麦克风
full_list.abstract: Photonic integrated circuits offer compactness, wafer-scale manufacturability and a fast-maturing fabrication base. Here we report what is, to our knowledge, the first fly-inspired directional microphone transduced by integrated photonics: two silicon-nitride microring resonators on opposite wings of a rocking diaphragm, monolithically released above a backside Bosch-etched cavity. Off-axis sound drives the antisymmetric rocking mode, straining one ring in tension and the other in compression; with the laser biased on each ring’s resonance slope, the opposite resonance shifts become two intensity signals of opposite phase, whose difference transduces the direction-bearing motion. The packaged device shows loaded optical quality factors of 18,635 and 17,974 near 1553 nm; scanning laser-Doppler vibrometry resolves the rocking mode near 15.8 kHz and the bending mode near 20.8 kHz. Tone-burst excitation at the two modal resonances demonstrates directional transduction directly in the time domain: at 90° incidence the two ring outputs oscillate in antiphase and their difference is enhanced, whereas at 180° they are in phase and the difference is suppressed. The optical response appears only after the acoustic time-of-flight and rings down after the drive ends, excluding electromagnetic pickup. Finite-element projections of an audio-band device, using shot-noise scaling, indicate an A-weighted signal-to-noise ratio of 74.6 dB(A), more than 10 dB beyond an optimized piezoelectric implementation of the same mechanics. These results constitute a proof-of-concept demonstration of a new transduction platform for chip-scale directional acoustic sensing, with a quantitative roadmap — higher optical quality factor, power— toward practical performance improvement.

full_list.abstract: Organic electrosynthesis driven by the renewable electricity and reacted in water offers a green route to prepare higher value-added formamide by constructing carbon–nitrogen (C–N) coupling reactions. Currently, electrochemical formamide synthesis focuses mainly on cathodic processes, required relatively expensive substrates and high electricity and equipment costs, which greatly hinders practical application in industry. Herein, we reported anodic electrosynthesis of formamide from mixed polyols and ammonia by a spin-induced polarization strategy. We proposed that alloying Fe sites into mesoporous CuO broke its long-range antiferromagnetic order and created spin-polarized surface with localized paramagnetic centers. Spin-induced polarization strategy promoted the formation and stabilization of *NH2 intermediates without overoxidation to unreacted NO3−, which behaved as the dominant nucleophile to mediate concerted C–C cleavage and C–N coupling reactions for selective formamide synthesis with minor byproducts at anode. In a flow cell, it delivered a superior formamide Faradaic efficiency of 70.4% and selectivity of 99.0%, with the high net profit of US1,598 per ton. Meanwhile, the strategy has generally been applied to mixed polyols substrates mimicking the real feedstock from renewable biomass, which further underscored promising industrial application potential. This work establishes a new paradigm to construct efficient C–N coupling reactions for various value-added amides by a spin-state engineering strategy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由可再生电力驱动并在水中反应的有机电合成提供了一条通过构建碳氮（C-N）偶联反应制备高附加值甲酰胺的绿色路线。目前，电化学甲酰胺合成主要集中在阴极过程，所需底物相对昂贵，电力和设备成本较高，极大地阻碍了工业实际应用。在此，我们报道了通过自旋诱导极化策略从混合多元醇和氨阳极电合成甲酰胺。我们提出，将 Fe 位点合金化到介孔 CuO 中，打破了其长程反铁磁有序，并产生了具有局部顺磁中心的自旋极化表面。

full_list.title_en: Genome-Wide Identification of the Potato MAPKKKK Gene Family Reveals StMAPKKKK1 as a Positive Regulator of Salt and Drought Tolerance
full_list.title_zh: 马铃薯 MAPKKKK 基因家族的全基因组鉴定揭示 StMAPKKKK1 是耐盐性和耐旱性的正调节因子
full_list.abstract: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase kinases (MAP4Ks/MAPKKKKs) reside at the apex of MAPK signalling cascades, yet their roles in potato abiotic stress responses remain unexplored. Here, we identified eight StMAPKKKK genes via genome-wide identification in potato. StMAPKKKK1 protein was strongly induced by salt and drought stress and localized to the plasma membrane and cytoplasm. Yeast two-hybrid (Y2H), bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC), and split-luciferase complementation (SLC) experiments show that StMAPKKKK1 physically interacts with StMAPKK2. To assess its function, we generated StMAPKKKK1-overexpressing (OE) and RNA interference (RNAi) lines in potato cultivar 'Atlantic'. OE lines exhibited improved growth, with higher plant height, biomass, and leaf number, whereas RNAi lines were more sensitive than non-transgenic (NT) controls under both salt and drought stress conditions. Higher activities of ascorbate peroxidase (APX), catalase (CAT), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and peroxidase (POD), as well as proline and total chlorophyll contents, along with lower levels of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and malondialdehyde (MDA) were observed in OE lines. In contrast, RNAi lines showed opposite trends for all above-mentioned parameters. These results indicate alleviated oxidative damage, enhanced osmotic adjustment, and better pigment retention. This study presents the first functional characterization of the StMAPKKKK family in potato and establishes StMAPKKKK1 as a positive regulator of salt and drought tolerance, acting at least partially through interaction with StMAPKK2 and activation of the antioxidant defense system.

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Classical-Quantum Learning for Space Based Data Centers: A CUDA-Q Study of Variational and Photonic Backends
full_list.title_zh: 基于空间的数据中心的混合经典量子学习：变分和光子后端的 CUDA-Q 研究
full_list.abstract: We study hybrid classical–quantum routing for a 10-node optical space-based data center (SBDC) with 30-second routing-table refresh, asking whether quantum-enhanced subroutines improve representation learning under realistic latency constraints. Our model uses a message-passing neural backbone and compares five backends within a common CUDA-Q workflow: a classical baseline, a photonic sampling-inspired node encoder, a VQC node encoder on qpp-cpu, the same VQC on nvidia, and an ORCA-style photonic edge augmentation. We evaluate routing accuracy, route success, latency per refresh, successful-route queue and congestion reduction, robustness under radiation/SEU-style stress, and backend-aware quantum diagnostics including node-state fidelity, expectation drift, boson-output statistics, and logical resource counts. The results are mixed but informative. The photonic backend achieves the highest held-out routing accuracy in the low-latency regime (about 0.60), while the classical and ORCA-edge variants remain close (roughly 0.56–0.58) at similarly low latency. By contrast, the VQC backends incur two to three orders of magnitude larger per-refresh latency for lower routing accuracy, although they produce richer quantum-state structure. Overall, the main result is a backend-grounded demonstration that classically controlled photonic and variational subroutines measurably alter routing representations and latency–utility trade-offs in optical LEO networking.

full_list.title_en: Identification of Novel Human-Specific Long Non-Coding RNAs in Spinal Cord Astrocytoma Through RNA-Seq Analysis
full_list.title_zh: 通过 RNA-Seq 分析鉴定脊髓星形细胞瘤中新型人类特异性长非编码 RNA
full_list.abstract: Human spinal cord aging is associated with molecular changes that may affect neuronal function and tissue homeostasis, but the role of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in this process remains poorly understood. In this study, RNA-sequencing data from young and old human spinal cord samples were analyzed using an integrated bioinformatics pipeline, including transcript assembly, novel lncRNA identification, differential expression analysis, co-expression analysis, functional enrichment, evolutionary conservation, and SNP analysis. A total of 1,669 novel lncRNAs were identified, among which three transcripts (MSTRG.24062.6, MSTRG.35781.3, and MSTRG.57931.6) were significantly differentially expressed between the young and old age groups. Functional enrichment of co-expressed genes highlighted processes related to protein targeting to membrane, synaptic signaling, neuron projection organization, calcium ion transport, and membrane potential regulation. KEGG pathway analysis identified adrenergic signaling in cardiomyocytes as the most significantly enriched pathway. Conservation analysis revealed that all identified novel lncRNAs were human-specific and unmapped to the mouse genome. Genetic variant analysis identified 11,243 variants across 496 novel lncRNAs, with SNPs accounting for more than 95%. Transitions were more frequent than transversions, and variant distribution varied across chromosomes and lncRNAs. A weak positive correlation between SNP count and lncRNA expression suggested a limited association between genetic variation and expression levels. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive characterization of novel lncRNAs associated with human spinal cord aging and establishes a foundation for future studies investigations into their potential regulatory roles in age related molecular changes in spinal cord aging.

full_list.title_en: Integrated bedrock and stream sediment geochemistry with multivariate analysis for mineral exploration in the Okemesi–Ijero Basement Complex, southwestern Nigeria
full_list.title_zh: 综合基岩和河流沉积物地球化学与多变量分析，用于尼日利亚西南部奥克梅西-伊杰罗地下室综合体的矿产勘探
full_list.abstract: Integrated geological mapping, bedrock and stream sediment geochemistry, and multivariate statistical analysis were applied to evaluate the mineralization potential of the Okemesi–Ijero area within the Precambrian Basement Complex of southwestern Nigeria. Detailed field mapping identified a polydeformed assemblage comprising quartzites of the Effon Psammite Formation, schists, migmatite–gneiss complexes, granitoids, pegmatites, calc-gneiss, and charnockites, reflecting a complex tectono-magmatic history. A total of 85 bedrock samples and 70 stream sediment samples were collected and analyzed for major and trace elements using inductively coupled plasma techniques following four-acid digestion and lithium borate fusion. Geochemical results show marked spatial variation in elemental concentrations across different lithologies and drainage systems. Granitic and pegmatitic rocks are enriched in lithophile and rare-metal-related elements, whereas polymetallic associations involving Cu, Pb, Zn, Mn, and Sn characterize granitoid and structurally disturbed zones. Stream sediment geochemistry effectively integrates upstream bedrock signatures, highlighting drainages influenced by granitic and pegmatitic sources and areas of elevated base-metal concentrations. Multivariate statistical analyses, including factor analysis, principal component analysis, and hierarchical cluster analysis, successfully discriminate background geochemical signatures from anomalous elemental populations and elucidate elemental associations related to lithology, magmatism, and secondary dispersion processes. The combined geological, geochemical, and statistical evidence indicates that the Okemesi–Ijero area is prospective for base-metal and rare-metal mineralization, particularly within granitic and pegmatitic domains and structurally favorable zones. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of integrating multivariate statistical techniques with conventional geological and geochemical methods for mineral exploration in complex basement terrains and provides a transferable framework for regional exploration targeting.
full_list.abstract_zh: 应用综合地质测绘、基岩和河流沉积物地球化学以及多元统计分析来评估尼日利亚西南部前寒武纪基底杂岩内的奥克迈西-伊杰罗地区的矿化潜力。详细的野外测绘确定了由埃芬砂岩地层石英岩、片岩、混合岩-片麻岩杂岩、花岗岩、伟晶岩、钙片麻岩和霞岩岩组成的多变形组合，反映了复杂的构造-岩浆历史。在四酸消解和硼酸锂熔融之后，使用电感耦合等离子体技术收集了总共 85 个基岩样品和 70 个溪流沉积物样品并分析了主要元素和微量元素。地球化学结果显示不同岩性和排水系统的元素浓度存在显着的空间变化。

full_list.title_en: Quantum gas microscope reveals individual atoms in first tunable three-component Hubbard system
full_list.title_zh: 量子气体显微镜揭示了第一个可调谐三组件哈伯德系统中的单个原子
full_list.abstract: For the first time, an international team of researchers from Germany, Thailand, India, China and the United States has created a three-component Hubbard system with tunable interactions in the laboratory. In doing so, the team used a quantum gas microscope to make the individual atoms visible. The study, published in Science, provides an important foundation for future quantum simulations of nuclear physics and materials science.

full_list.title_en: Revealing Hidden Orbital Pathways in Non-Thermal Hot Carrier Relaxation of MXenes via Non-Secular Redfield Quantum Kinetics
full_list.title_zh: 通过非世俗红场量子动力学揭示 MXene 非热载流子弛豫中的隐藏轨道路径
full_list.abstract: Non-thermal carrier relaxation is routinely inferred from population dynamics or spectroscopic observables, yet neither class of quantity uniquely identifies the microscopic channels through which energy and coherence are redistributed. We introduce a pathway-resolved quantum-kinetic framework that simultaneously projects ultrafast relaxation onto orbital populations, directional inter-orbital transferes, coherence, spectroscopic visibility, and a hidden-pathway sector of the dynamical transfer network. Application to MXenes exposes strongly non-uniform orbital redistribution together with material-specific hierarchies of microscopic transfer channels. Temperature, excitation amplitude, and dissipative parameters modulate pathway competition and spectral amplitudes while leaving the identity of the dominant channels largely intact. Instantaneous transfer contributions, cumulative directional transfer, coherence, and spectroscopic visibility are shown to follow inequivalent hierarchical orderings. This non-equivalence isolates a set of hidden pathways that remain dynamically consequential despite weak conventional spectroscopic signatures. The resulting time–energy–coherence representation recasts non-thermal relaxation as a structured dynamical network comprising observable and hidden sectors, thereby providing a general methodology for resolving microscopic orbital-transfer pathways in driven quantum materials.

full_list.abstract: Traditional lenses and mirrors focus light using curved surfaces. Metasurfaces can achieve similar functions with a flat layer of nanoscale structures that locally control the phase of light. Extending these flat optics into the ultraviolet could support compact systems for high-resolution imaging, spectroscopy, and sensing, but it introduces a fundamental materials problem: many of the materials used to make metasurfaces strongly absorb UV light.

full_list.title_en: Spectral fits with full broadening for kHz-iteration high-accuracy gas-phase spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: 光谱拟合完全展宽 kHz 迭代高精度气相光谱
full_list.abstract: This work presents methods enabling real-time multi-species direct absorption spectroscopic fitting at kilohertz iteration rates with high accuracy of spectral line shapes on embedded systems. Precomputation of multi-dimensional polynomials and effective pressures allows high accuracy approximation of HITRAN Hartmann-Tran absorption coefficients with full matrix broadening and low residual error, replacing computationally slow line-by-line simulations and inaccurate fixed-basis functions. A novel Levenberg--Marquardt solver augmented with Taguchi orthogonal array exploration accelerates fitting convergence and escapes local minima. Together, these methods enable simulated implementations that fit 1000-point spectra with simultaneous etalon fringe, temperature, and pressure estimation at 1~kHz using 0.8~W simulated computational power for a single laser system. This work further simulates a simultaneous dual-laser single-detector architecture exploiting co-prime spectral lengths, fitting six concentration parameters at 0.82~kHz using 1.6~W simulated computational power. Mid-infrared TDLAS simulations targeting CH4, H2O, C2H6, CO2, and N2O provide an approach for possible atmospheric sensing deployments and chemical kinetics studies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 这项工作提出了能够以千赫兹迭代速率进行实时多物种直接吸收光谱拟合的方法，并且在嵌入式系统上具有高精度的谱线形状。多维多项式和有效压力的预计算可以高精度逼近 HITRAN Hartmann-Tran 吸收系数，具有全矩阵展宽和低残差误差，取代了计算缓慢的逐行模拟和不准确的固定基函数。一种新颖的 Levenberg-Marquardt 求解器增强了 Taguchi 正交阵列探索，可加速拟合收敛并摆脱局部最小值。

full_list.abstract: A new interface detection technique is proposed to identify turbulent/non-turbulent interfaces (TNTIs) in temporally-evolving flows, and its efficiency in comparison to existing techniques is assessed for two fundamentally different test cases. The first consisted of a temporally-evolving cylinder wake, and the second a decaying stream of grid-turbulence. The turbulent flows were marked with a high Schmidt number dye and combined PIV/PLIF experiments were performed. The TNTIs were identified using PLIF image intensity and intensity-gradient based methods. Since the bulk concentration decayed with time, a time dependent normalisation of the images had to be performed in all methods. A novel intensity-based method was proposed where the intensity field was transformed using a combination of pixel-based intensity and the corresponding cross-stream, y, location. The efficacy of the different methods were compared using metrics such as total enstrophy contained within the interface and enstrophy gradient along the interface. The new intensity-based method showed a superior performance as it captured both high total enstrophy and enstrophy gradient.

full_list.title_en: Acoustic Detection of Spaceflight Fluid Shift: A Consistent In-Flight Decline in Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio Across Three ISS Crew Members, with an Operational Model for Voice-Based Crew Health Monitoring
full_list.title_zh: 航天流体变化的声学检测：国际空间站三名机组成员的谐波噪声比在飞行中持续下降，以及基于语音的机组人员健康监测操作模型
full_list.abstract: Cephalad fluid redistribution is among the earliest and most consistent physiological consequences of orbital insertion, yet it is difficult to monitor in flight: the measurements that resolve it require consumables, hardware mass, or crew time that exploration-class missions cannot spare. Voice is a candidate readout — phonation depends on vocal-fold surface hydration and viscoelasticity, both of which fluid shift perturbs — but no controlled in-orbit vocal corpus has previously existed against which to test it. We report such a corpus and the result of that test. Three International Space Station crew members performed a fixed vocal battery on a certified crew tablet, twice daily, across a pre-flight phase and mission days 3–14, yielding 44 sessions and 254 verified recordings with a pre-flight baseline acquired through an identical acquisition path. Every recording was retained in two parallel forms — the raw acquisition and the same material after a noise-suppression stage — and both were measured with a single Praat/Parselmouth pipeline. Harmonics-to-noise ratio (HNR) declined between the pre-flight and in-flight phases in seven of the eight testable crew × vowel cells, median − 2.11 dB. At the recording level, with all three vowels pooled and each crew member's own pre-flight median subtracted, the decline is − 2.70 dB (23 pre-flight vs 96 in-flight recordings, p = 0.019), reaching significance within a single crew member (− 5.53 dB, p = 0.011, rank-biserial − 0.72); restricted to the two vowels sampled completely in every crew member it is 6 of 6 cells at − 2.47 dB (p = 0.0038). The effect is specific to HNR: shimmer and CPPS, which share its sensitivity to added acquisition noise, decline in only 2 and 3 of 8 cells respectively, so a drift in recording conditions between phases — which would have displaced all three together — does not explain it. A reduction in HNR is an increase in turbulent, aperiodic energy during phonation, the direction predicted by laryngeal mucosal fluid loading. The change presents as a sustained step between phases rather than a progressive in-flight trend, consistent with fluid shift reaching a new steady state within hours of insertion. Because acoustic measurements are vulnerable to their acquisition chain, we established what that chain contributes before interpreting the result. Retaining both processing versions allowed this to be measured directly: the noise-suppression stage moves shimmer by − 3.35% and HNR by + 3.56 dB (paired, n = 63, p ≈ 10⁻¹¹), while leaving F₀ and CPPS unchanged (CPPS p = 0.94). The phase contrast above is computed within a single processing version, so this term cancels; quantifying it is what licenses the physiological reading rather than undermining it. The same contrast applied to 135 voluntary cough recordings gives no consistent direction in any measure, which we report as evidence for task selection: sustained phonation is self-normalising, whereas cough acoustics depend on applied effort and instantaneous mouth-to-microphone geometry. We report two further chain properties for reuse: cough timing depends 9.90-fold on segmentation convention, and within-session dimensionless ratios are stable across processing versions (within-crew CV 11.3–15.0%). The operational case is quantified: 18.2 s of crew recording time, zero consumables, zero incremental mass, and 624 B of downlink per session against 568 KiB of raw audio — a 932-fold reduction with on-board measurement. We give design requirements for follow-on missions in directly usable form: nine sessions per phase per crew member reach d = 1.5 at 80% power, against d ≥ 1.91 permitted here, and pre-flight sessions cost nothing in flight resources. No blood or imaging reference was obtained, so the fluid-shift attribution is an interpretation consistent with the observed direction and specificity rather than a demonstrated mechanism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 头侧液体重新分布是轨道插入最早、最一致的生理后果之一，但在飞行中很难监测：解决它的测量需要消耗品、硬件质量或机组人员时间，而这些都是探索级任务无法抽出的。声音是一个候选读数——发声取决于声带表面水合作用和粘弹性，这两者都会造成流体转移的干扰——但之前不存在受控的在轨声带语料库来对其进行测试。我们报告这样的语料库和测试结果。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 头侧液体重新分布是轨道插入最早、最一致的生理后果之一，但在飞行中很难监测：解决它的测量需要消耗品、硬件质量或机组人员时间，而这些都是探索级任务无法抽出的。声音是一个候选读数——发声取决于声带表面水合作用和粘弹性，这两者都会造成流体转移的干扰——但之前不存在受控的在轨声带语料库来对其进行测试。我们报告这样的语料库和测试结果。三名国际空间站机组人员在经过认证的机组平板电脑上每天两次在飞行前阶段和任务第 3-14 天进行固定声乐电池测试，产生 44 个会话和 254 个经过验证的录音，并通过相同的采集路径获取飞行前基线。每个录音都以两种并行形式保留——原始采集和噪声抑制阶段后的相同材料——并且两者都使用单个 Praat/Parselmouth 管道进行测量。在 8 个可测试机组 × 元音单元中的 7 个中，谐波噪声比 (HNR) 在飞行前和飞行中阶段之间有所下降，中值 − 2.11 dB。在记录水平上，将所有三个元音合并并减去每位机组人员自己的飞行前中位数，下降为− 2.70 dB（23个飞行前记录与96个飞行中记录，p = 0.019），在单个机组成员内达到显着性（− 5.53 dB，p = 0.011，秩双列 − 0.72);仅限于在每个机组成员中完全采样的两个元音，它是 6 个单元中的 6 个单元，频率为 - 2.47 dB (p = 0.0038)。这种效应是 HNR 所特有的：微光和 CPPS 对增加的采集噪声都同样敏感，但仅在 8 个单元中的 2 个和 3 个中分别下降，因此阶段之间记录条件的漂移（这将同时取代所有三个单元）并不能解释这一现象。 HNR 的减少是发声期间湍流、非周期性能量的增加，这是由喉粘膜液体负荷预测的方向。这种变化表现为阶段之间的持续步骤，而不是渐进的飞行趋势，这与插入后数小时内达到新的稳定状态的液体转移一致。由于声学测量很容易受到其采集链的影响，因此我们在解释结果之前确定了该采集链的贡献。保留这两个处理版本可以直接测量：噪声抑制阶段将闪光移动 - 3.35%，将 HNR 移动 + 3.56 dB（配对，n = 63，p ≈ 10 10 11），同时保持 F₀ 和 CPPS 不变（CPPS p = 0.94）。上面的相衬是在单个处理版本内计算的，因此该术语取消；量化它是许可生理读数而不是破坏它的原因。同样的对比应用于 135 个自愿咳嗽录音，在任何测量中都没有给出一致的方向，我们将其报告为任务选择的证据：持续发声是自我正常化的，而咳嗽声学取决于施加的努力和瞬时嘴到麦克风的几何形状。我们报告了两个进一步的链属性以供重用：咳嗽时间取决于分段约定的 9.90 倍，并且会话内无量纲比率在整个处理版本中保持稳定（工作人员内 CV 11.3-15.0%）。操作案例被量化：18.2 秒的工作人员录音时间、零耗材、零增量质量、每个会话的下行链路为 624 B，而原始音频为 568 KiB — 通过机载测量减少了 932 倍。我们以可直接使用的形式给出后续任务的设计要求：每个机组人员每阶段 9 次训练，在 80% 功率下达到 d = 1.5，而此处允许的 d ≥ 1.91，并且飞行前训练不消耗任何飞行资源。没有获得血液或成像参考，因此液体转移归因是与观察到的方向和特异性一致的解释，而不是已证实的机制。

Here, the authors show how the bacteria switch between attachment and surface movement by coordinating the two signalling systems, allowing distinct bacterial populations to work together to colonise and damage human airway tissue.

full_list.title_en: Between marine and continental air: atmospheric CO₂ variability and local wind associations in coastal Taizhou, China
full_list.title_zh: 海洋和大陆空气之间：大气二氧化碳变化和中国台州沿海的局地风关联
full_list.abstract: Atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) observations at Hongjia, Taizhou, from April 2023 to November 2024 were analyzed using statistical methods, backward-trajectory clustering, the weighted potential source contribution function, and cross-tabulation of trajectory over-ocean fractions and local winds. The mean mole fraction was (440.61 ± 14.0) × 10⁻⁶, lower than at the inland Lin’an station. Concentrations were higher in winter and spring, lower in summer and autumn, and highest around dawn and lowest in the afternoon. Wind speed was negatively correlated with CO₂ in all seasons; W–WSW winds were associated with higher concentrations. The 72 h trajectories were classified as continental (over-ocean fraction f ≤ 0.2), mixed (0.2 < f < 0.8), or marine (f ≥ 0.8). The over-ocean fraction was negatively correlated with CO₂ (r = − 0.367). Marine pathways combined with SE–S winds and speeds ≥ 3 m s⁻¹ yielded a mean of 425.8 × 10⁻⁶, whereas continental-pathway means ranged from 448.1 to 449.2 × 10⁻⁶ under different wind filters. Weak westerlies across pathways corresponded to 451.5 × 10⁻⁶, increasing to 459.3 × 10⁻⁶ in winter. Within pathway classes, weak-westerly means exceeded those under other valid wind conditions by 6.9–12.8 × 10⁻⁶. These contrasts cannot independently quantify local anthropogenic contributions. Potential source regions included the Zhejiang–Fujian coast, the Jiangsu–Anhui border, and North China. The findings characterize coastal CO₂ variability associated with regional transport, local transport and dispersion, and terrestrial ecosystem exchange.

full_list.abstract: Minimum quantity lubrication can reduce fluid consumption while increasing compressed air demand, making its carbon advantage dependent on machining quality and tooling performance. This study develops an analytical method for selecting cooling strategies using emissions per accepted turned component. The method combines machine electricity, compressed air, net fluid consumption, cutting edge service and rejected workpieces within a consistent product boundary. Closed form expressions establish the minimum acceptable yield, maximum air demand and minimum cutting edge capacity required for minimum quantity lubrication to outperform flood cooling. An explicitly assumed steel turning case demonstrates the calculations without claiming experimental validation. At the selected electricity factor, minimum quantity lubrication reduces carbon intensity from 4.7177 to 4.6949 kg carbon dioxide equivalent per accepted component, a conditional improvement of 0.48%. Increasing rejection from 2% to 3% reverses that ranking. The corresponding air threshold is 1.558 cubic metres per attempted component. Joint interval analysis also identifies conditions under which neither strategy dominates. The contribution is a reproducible decision method that connects cooling selection to measurable production limits and identifies the evidence required for industrial verification.
full_list.abstract_zh: 微量润滑可以减少流体消耗，同时增加压缩空气需求，使其碳优势取决于加工质量和工具性能。本研究开发了一种分析方法，用于使用每个可接受的车削部件的排放来选择冷却策略。该方法将机器电力、压缩空气、净流体消耗、尖端服务和报废工件结合在一致的产品范围内。闭式表达式确定了最小量润滑所需的最小可接受产量、最大空气需求和最小切削刃容量，以优于淹没冷却。明确假设的钢车削案例演示了计算结果，但没有要求实验验证。

full_list.title_en: Method for Digital Information Continuity in the Context of Short-Cycled Factory Replanning
full_list.title_zh: 短周期工厂重新规划背景下的数字信息连续性方法
full_list.abstract: Factory operators face a challenging business environment, necessitating more frequent factory upgrades. State-of-the-art approaches for factory planning include extensive data preparation efforts, accounting for approximately 60% of the total planning effort. Within the last few years, model-based approaches such as building information modelling have significantly improved factory planning efficiency. However, the holistic digital factory models that stand at the end of the factory planning phase are not effectively transferred into the operational phase. They are, therefore, not linked to the digital twin and are not updated during the operation phase. Consequently, these digital factory models become outdated and cannot be used for subsequent factory replanning. Based on a structured literature review and two focus group discussions, this paper proposes a new method for transferring holistic digital factory models into the operations phase and to provide an updated digital factory model at the interface to the next replanning phase. The feasibility of this method is validated at the application scenario of a laboratory for additive multi-material manufacturing with data from energy monitoring and MES.

full_list.title_en: Resilience of Sub-10 nm MoSi2N4 and WSi2N4 TFETs Against Surface Roughness: Device and Digital Applications
full_list.title_zh: 亚 10 nm MoSi2N4 和 WSi2N4 TFET 对表面粗糙度的恢复能力：设备和数字应用
full_list.abstract: Monolayers of the ((MA₂Z₄)) family, particularly ((MoSi₂N₄)) and ((WSi₂N₄)), are promising channel materials for steep-slope tunnel field-effect transistors (TFETs) in beyond-CMOS electronics. However, interface imperfections introduce critical device variability. Here, we investigate the impact of substrate surface roughness on sub-10 nm ((MoSi₂N₄)) and ((WSi₂N₄)) TFETs using a tight-binding model within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The surface corrugation induces localized midgap states, triggering parasitic trap-assisted tunneling that elevates the OFF-current and degrades the sub-threshold swing. Although both 2D channels show strong resilience up to an RMS roughness of ((δ h approx 150))pm-maintaining intrinsic delays as fast as ((τ approx 0.20--0.25)) ps at ((L_ch = 3)) nm-higher roughness severely suppresses the ON-current and compresses the ON-OFF current ratio by four orders of magnitude. Monolayer ((WSi₂N₄)) consistently demonstrates superior electrostatic robustness compared to ((MoSi₂N₄)). Furthermore, inverter simulations reveal degraded transition slope with surface roughness. These results emphasize the need for atomically smooth substrates or planarization techniques to preserve steep-slope switching in scaled 2D nanoelectronics.

full_list.title_en: Sensitivity analysis of reverse engineering approaches for 3D-scanned welds with complex geometries
full_list.title_zh: 复杂几何形状 3D 扫描焊缝逆向工程方法的敏感性分析
full_list.abstract: High stress concentrations are primarily caused by variations in the weld surface geometry and can lead to fatigue failure. 3D scanning technology combined with reverse engineering is becoming more widely used to capture detailed surface geometries and to build numerical models for further fatigue analysis. However, studies on the influence of different scanning systems, pointing spacing, and modeling approaches are limited. For this reason, a sensitivity analysis is needed to evaluate the reliability of the reverse engineering approach. Two scanning systems, fringe light projection (FLP) and laser line sensor (LLS), with different resolutions were applied to welded specimens with complex geometries. The stress concentration factors (SCFs) were determined using finite element analysis (FEA) based on the surface scans (point clouds). Two different modeling methods, connecting parts with tie connections or through sub modeling were compared. In addition, different element size and type, shape functions were used in the FEA. To cover the effect of near surface variation of weld quality and stress concentrations, critical distance theory (CDT) approach was applied. full_list.abstract: This study investigates the effects of shot peening (SP) performed after solution treatment (ST) and aging on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and surface quality of AlSi10Mg alloy produced by selective laser melting (SLM). ST was conducted at 540°C for 2 hours, followed by aging at 180°C for 6 hours, whereas SP was performed using various processing parameters. Microstructural examinations, tensile tests, and analyses of microhardness, density, and 3D surface topography were performed. The results indicated that ST and aging reduced tensile strength while increasing elongation at break. SP increased the yield strength of the heat-treated samples; for the sample subjected to SP after aging, this value exceeded that of the as-built condition (reaching 267 MPa). Furthermore, SP reduced surface roughness across all processing conditions. The lowest Ra and Rq values, 0.30 µm and 0.40 µm, respectively, were observed in the sample subjected to SP after ST. Conversely, the near-surface microcracks and reduced ductility observed after SP highlighted the need for a comprehensive evaluation of mechanical properties. The findings demonstrate that SP is a complementary process that enhances the mechanical properties and surface quality of the heat-treated AlSi10Mg; however, processing parameters must be optimized with due consideration for surface integrity and ductility.

full_list.title_zh: 用于评估渐进式板材成形过程中摩擦系数的刀具路径策略
full_list.abstract: Owing to its inherent flexibility, low tooling costs, and enhanced formability, incremental sheet forming is particularly suitable for the rapid manufacturing of high-value-added, small-batch, and customized complex sheet components. However, the tribological conditions at the tool/sheet interface play a crucial role in governing material deformation. The presence of highly localized contact pressures adds significant complexity to the interpretation and modelling of frictional behaviour within the process. The aim of the present study is to evaluate the coefficient of friction between the forming tool and the sheet in the incremental sheet forming process. To this end, a flat-head forming tool is employed, and a dedicated toolpath is developed. The parameter under investigation is measured through an in-depth understanding of the typical issues affecting incrementally formed components and a careful interpretation of the forming force signals. Finite element analyses support the results from the experimental campaign.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由于其固有的灵活性、较低的模具成本和增强的可成形性，渐进式板材成形特别适合快速制造高附加值、小批量和定制的复杂板材部件。然而，工具/板材界面的摩擦条件在控制材料变形方面起着至关重要的作用。高度局部接触压力的存在显着增加了过程中摩擦行为的解释和建模的复杂性。本研究的目的是评估渐进式板材成形过程中成形工具和板材之间的摩擦系数。为此，采用平头成形刀具，并开发了专用刀具路径。所研究的参数是通过深入了解影响渐进成形部件的典型问题以及仔细解释成形力信号来测量的。

full_list.title_en: Recovery and Characterization of Yellow Lentil Protein by Alkaline Extraction and Isoelectric Precipitation Considering Mass Balance, Nutritional Quality, and Techno-functional Properties
full_list.title_zh: 考虑质量平衡、营养品质和技术功能特性，通过碱提取和等电沉淀回收和表征黄扁豆蛋白
full_list.abstract: Lentil proteins are increasingly recognized as promising plant-based protein ingredients. Accordingly, the present study quantified individual, quadratic, and interactive effects of key alkaline extraction and isoelectric precipitation parameters on lentil protein recovery, using response surface designs for factor-effect estimation. In addition, a complete mass balance across the extraction process was established to identify major sources of protein loss. Conditions selected based on the estimated factor effects and process feasibility (5% (w/w), pH 9, 50 °C, 30 minutes for alkaline extraction; pH 5, 20 °C, 30 minutes for isoelectric precipitation) resulted in a protein content of 85.45% and a protein yield of 72.11%. The second centrifugation step was identified as the major source of protein loss, highlighting a key target for future process optimization. The resulting lentil protein concentrate exhibited high re-solubility (87.72%), foaming capacity and stability of 60.9% and 81.1%, respectively, excellent emulsifying properties (181.7% emulsion capacity, 99.7% emulsion stability), as well as favorable water and oil holding capacities (3.95 and 1.52 g/g, respectively). These properties, along with its light beige color, indicate lentil protein's potential for use in different food systems. Amino acid analysis revealed a balanced profile with high levels of glutamic acid, aspartic acid, lysine, and threonine, while sulfur-containing amino acids remained limiting. Indispensable amino acid contents met FAO requirements. A lentil-specific nitrogen-to-protein conversion factor of 5.64 was calculated, demonstrating that the conventional factor of 6.25 overestimates true protein content. Application of the corrected factor resulted in a protein content of 77.11%.

full_list.title_en: DualTrust: Asymmetric Bayesian Reputation and Cryptographic Gating for Autonomous AI Agents
full_list.title_zh: DualTrust：自主 AI 代理的非对称贝叶斯声誉和加密门控
full_list.abstract: The proliferation of Ambient Wearable Intelligence (AWI) ecosystems, spanning augmented reality glasses, smartwatches, and pervasive edge IoT actuators, is fundamentally transitioning human-AI interaction from explicit tactile commands to continuous, implicit background tool delegation. In these ambient environments, autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents are granted operational authority to invoke external APIs, reserve financial micro-quotas, and control physical actuators. However, existing safety guardrails depend on secondary LLM-as-a-judge classifiers that introduce prohibitive runtime latencies (400–850 ms) and recurring token expenses, while static role-based access control fails against continuous behavioral drift, memory backdoors, and interleaved salami-slicing exploits. We present DualTrust, an asymmetric Bayesian reputation and cryptographic gating runtime engineered for autonomous multi-agent containment. DualTrust enforces a decoupled principal-agent architecture that strictly isolates Human Principal Accountable Credit from Bayesian Agent Operational Standing. Agent behavior is continuously modulated via an asymmetric power-law slashing engine (Δβ ∝ (sev · c²) · vₐ¹.8) with instantaneous clean-streak reset, deterministic SHA-256 64-bucket striped concurrency locks, atomically locked rollback refunds, and an O(1) RAM sliding-window RFC 6962 Merkle audit ledger with rolling epoch seals that bounds active memory consumption by committing historical roots to persistent storage. Evaluated across 176 automated invariant tests and 10,000-cycle Monte Carlo attack simulations, DualTrust makes deterministic authorization verdicts in a median latency of 47.10 µs in-memory (mean 63.16 µs, tail p99 287.10 µs) and 155.80 µs under persistent SQLite WAL disk transactions, with end-to-end Python decorator wrappers executing in median 60.70 µs (async) and 88.30 µs (sync) without external API calls. Compared against state-of-the-art LLM guardrails, DualTrust achieves over 6,600× lower latency (and over 32× to 50× lower latency than localized AST validators), by policy construction blocks Sybil defamation against collusive probation swarms, and provides tamper-evident, append-only audit durability with RFC 6962 inclusion verification, establishing a practical, foundational governance runtime for trustworthy ambient intelligence.

full_list.abstract_zh_full: 环境可穿戴智能 (AWI) 生态系统的激增，涵盖增强现实眼镜、智能手表和无处不在的边缘物联网执行器，正在从根本上将人机交互从显式触觉命令转变为连续、隐式后台工具委托。在这些周围环境中，自主大语言模型（LLM）代理被授予调用外部API、保留财务微配额和控制物理执行器的操作权限。然而，现有的安全护栏依赖于二级 LLM 作为法官分类器，这会带来令人望而却步的运行时延迟（400-850 毫秒）和经常性的令牌费用，而基于静态角色的访问控制则无法抵御持续的行为漂移、内存后门和交错的萨拉米切片漏洞。我们推出 DualTrust，这是一种非对称贝叶斯信誉和加密门控运行时，专为自主多智能体遏制而设计。 DualTrust 强制实施解耦的委托-代理架构，将人类委托人责任信用与贝叶斯代理运营信誉严格隔离。代理行为通过非对称幂律削减引擎 (Δβ ∝ (sev · c²) · vₐ1.8) 进行连续调节，具有瞬时干净条纹重置、确定性 SHA-256 64 桶条带并发锁、原子锁定回滚退款以及 O(1) RAM 滑动窗口 RFC 6962 Merkle 审计分类账，具有限制活动内存的滚动纪元密封通过将历史根提交到持久存储来消耗。通过 176 个自动不变测试和 10,000 周期蒙特卡罗攻击模拟进行评估，DualTrust 做出确定性授权判决，内存中延迟中值为 47.10 µs（平均 63.16 µs，tail p99 287.10 µs），持久 SQLite WAL 磁盘事务下延迟为 155.80 µs，端到端 Python 装饰器包装器以中值执行60.70 µs（异步）和 88.30 µs（同步），无需外部 API 调用。与最先进的 LLM 防护栏相比，DualTrust 通过策略构建阻止 Sybil 诽谤来对抗共谋缓刑群，实现了超过 6,600 倍的低延迟（比本地化 AST 验证器低超过 32 倍到 50 倍的延迟），并通过 RFC 6962 包含验证提供防篡改、仅附加的审计持久性，为值得信赖的环境智能建立了实用的基础治理运行时。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

core_items.title_en: Conditional Phase Sensitivity and Atom–RestCorrelations in a Diamond Four-LevelOptomechanical Cavity
core_items.title_zh: 金刚石四能级光机械腔中的条件相敏性和原子静止相关性
core_items.abstract: We investigate how phase information initially stored in a diamond four-level atom is redistributed when the atom interacts with a quantized cavity field and a mechanical mode. The phase φ is encoded in the atomic superposition (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2, while the optical and mechanical subsystems start in Fock states. The dynamics are generated by a coarse-grained optomechanical Hamiltonian together with normalized non-Hermitian no-jump evolution. A central point of the analysis is that the induced |2rangle↔|3rangle channel contains the distinct photon operators adagger ka^k and a^kadagger k; they cannot be merged without changing the dynamics. The numerical study is deliberately restricted to the stationary, single-photon case k=1, for which the calculation is reproducible and the Hilbert-space truncation can be checked directly. We track the reduced-atomic quantum Fisher information (QFI), von Neumann entropy, purity, and total l₁ coherence. In the parameter range considered, increasing the optomechanical coupling G reduces the maximum conditioned atom--rest entropy from about 1.676 to 0.374 bits and raises the minimum atomic purity from about 0.356 to 0.876. At the same time, the time-averaged local QFI decreases from about 0.450 to 0.336, while the mean total coherence changes only weakly and non-monotonically. Thus stronger optomechanical coupling does not improve all quantum resources simultaneously: it keeps the conditioned atomic state purer and less entangled with the rest, but it also reduces the amount of phase information locally accessible from the atom. To expose this contrast more clearly, the time-dependent observables are plotted for two complementary combinations of G values, and the full nine-point coupling scan is summarized separately.

core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了当原子与量子化腔场和机械模式相互作用时，最初存储在金刚石四能级原子中的相位信息如何重新分布。相位 φ 以原子叠加 (|1rangle+eⁱφ|2rangle)/sqrt2 编码，而光学和机械子系统以 Fock 状态启动。动力学是由粗粒度光机械哈密顿量与归一化非厄米无跳演化一起生成的。分析的中心点是诱导 |2rangle↔|3rangle 通道包含不同的光子算子 adagger ka^k 和 a^kadagger k；如果不改变动态，它们就无法合并。数值研究有意限制在稳态、单光子情况 k=1 的情况下，计算是可重复的，并且可以直接检查希尔伯特空间截断。我们跟踪简化原子量子费希尔信息 (QFI)、冯诺依曼熵、纯度和总 l₁ 相干性。在所考虑的参数范围内，增加光机耦合 G 可将最大条件原子静止熵从约 1.676 降低至 0.374 位，并将最小原子纯度从约 0.356 提高至 0.876。与此同时，时间平均局部 QFI 从大约 0.450 下降到 0.336，而平均总相干性仅微弱且非单调地变化。因此，更强的光机耦合并不能同时改善所有量子资源：它使条件原子态保持更纯净并且与其余原子态的纠缠更少，但它也减少了从原子本地访问的相位信息量。为了更清楚地揭示这种对比，针对 G 值的两个互补组合绘制了随时间变化的可观测值，并单独总结了完整的九点耦合扫描。

core_items.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 07 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79077-5 Manipulating Majorana bound states is a key requirement for topological quantum computation. Here, the authors propose a topological insulator Josephson trijunction in a magnetic field that enables the generation, transport, and fusion of Majorana bound states through static control of superconducting phases.
